app.notes: Runs the official browser version of VidBee: apps/web (TanStack Start production build, served by apps/web/server.mjs on PORT) proxying /rpc, /events, /files and /images to the self-hosted API (apps/api, bundled to apps/api/dist with its own esbuild script, SQLite via better-sqlite3 at .ui-capture/data/vidbee/vidbee.db, API on PORT+10000). start.sh re-runs .ui-capture/seed.mjs on every start (dates stay relative to now), which writes into the app's own schema (schema.sql dumped from the API DDL): ~8 months of download history across YouTube, Bilibili, Vimeo, SoundCloud, Twitch, X and TikTok (mostly completed, plus failed downloads with real yt-dlp error messages such as 429, members-only, geo-blocked or removed videos, and some cancelled ones), a playlist download group ('Study Mixes 2026'), an active queue (3 downloading with live progress, 2 queued, 2 paused, 1 retry-scheduled after HTTP 429), and 8 RSS subscriptions with their feed items (one disabled, one failing with 404, keyword filters, audio-only podcast subscription). Completed downloads have sparse placeholder files of realistic size under .ui-capture/data/downloads so file-exists checks pass. Main areas: Download (active queue + history with platform/status filters, new-download dialog backed by the yt-dlp stub), Subscriptions, Settings, About. No login is required.
